events.name: Meron • Menares • Macbride: Live at The Sound Room Release Show
events.notes: Pianist and composer Daniel Meron and his trio deliver a set of highly melodic, expressive music to celebrate their upcoming release, Live at The Sound Room. Featuring bassist Pablo Menares and drummer Jimmy Macbride, the group presents original modern jazz infused with Middle Eastern and Latin American influences. These three musicians—all fixtures of the New York City jazz scene for over 15 years—perform Meron's compositions in a highly democratic manner, focusing on interplay, self-expression, and spontaneity. As captured on the new album, the show offers a definitive look into Meron’s rich songbook and the band's sophisticated approach to the modern piano trio, resulting in an exhilarating and joyful experience. · · “Meron’s songs are defined by a melodic, lyrical, style that is immediately engaging... his piano sound is crystal clear, precise and beautiful..." - All About Jazz Two sets: 7:30pm, 9pm.
